doc.mx.xdocs-index-html.2.1: Geserd signs and delivers the message from your own domain, retrying temporary failures for you.
doc.mx.xdocs-index-html.2.2: You learn what happened from the log, the Metrics page and webhooks: delivered, bounced, complained.
doc.mx.xdocs-index-html.2.3: Replies come back to the same address and reach your server as email.received events.
doc.mx.xdocs-index-html.4.0: The HTTP API for new code. See the guides for Node.js, Python and PHP.
doc.mx.xdocs-index-html.4.1: SMTP for software that already sends mail, such as a CMS or an online shop.
doc.mx.xdocs-index-html.4.2: The dashboard for sending a broadcast or a template without writing code.
doc.mx.xdocs-index-html.6: New to email? Open the section for non-developers. Ready to code? Start with the Quickstart, then read the concepts and the going-live checklist before your first real send.
doc.mx.xdocs-quickstart-index-ht.2: For every domain Geserd shows four kinds of records. The exact values are in your dashboard under Domains; the table shows what each one is for. Copy the values exactly, without adding the domain name to the host twice.
doc.mx.xdocs-quickstart-index-ht.3.r0: Says Geserd may send for your domain.
doc.mx.xdocs-quickstart-index-ht.3.r1: Holds the public key that proves your messages are genuine.
doc.mx.xdocs-quickstart-index-ht.3.r2: Sends incoming mail to Geserd. Needed only to receive.
doc.mx.xdocs-quickstart-index-ht.3.r3: Tells receivers what to do when a check fails.
doc.mx.xdocs-quickstart-index-ht.4: Check that the records are live
doc.mx.xdocs-quickstart-index-ht.6: If a command prints nothing, the record has not spread yet or was added under the wrong host. Wait a few minutes and try again, then compare the host name letter by letter with the dashboard.
doc.mx.xdocs-quickstart-index-ht.8.0: The domain is added twice. Some panels append the domain themselves, so enter only geserd._domainkey and not the full name.
doc.mx.xdocs-quickstart-index-ht.8.1: Quotes or line breaks slipped into a long DKIM value. Paste it as one line.
doc.mx.xdocs-quickstart-index-ht.8.2: Two SPF records. A domain may have only one SPF record; merge the entries instead of adding a second.
doc.mx.xdocs-quickstart-index-ht.10: Until the domain is verified you can send only to your own account address. This is on purpose: it lets you test the whole flow safely. After verification the limit disappears and you can write to anyone.
doc.mx.xdocs-api-index-html.2.0: Base address: https://geserd.com/api. Every path in this reference is relative to it.
doc.mx.xdocs-api-index-html.2.1: Format: requests and responses are JSON with Content-Type: application/json.
doc.mx.xdocs-api-index-html.2.4: Status codes: 2xx success, 4xx your request, 5xx our side.
doc.mx.xdocs-api-index-html.4.r0: Send a message, check it and read its status.
doc.mx.xdocs-api-index-html.4.r4: Store messages and send them with variables.
doc.mx.xdocs-errors-index-html.2.r0: No valid API key, or the key was revoked.
doc.mx.xdocs-errors-index-html.2.r1: The sender domain is not verified yet.
doc.mx.xdocs-errors-index-html.2.r2: The account is frozen. Sending is paused until it is resolved.
doc.mx.xdocs-errors-index-html.2.r4: The resource does not exist or belongs to another account.
doc.mx.xdocs-errors-index-html.2.r5: A template or variable you referenced is missing.
doc.mx.xdocs-errors-index-html.2.r6: The message was rejected by the spam check. The response lists the rules.
doc.mx.xdocs-errors-index-html.2.r7: The plan limit for this action was reached.
doc.mx.xdocs-errors-index-html.2.r8: Too many requests in a short time. Wait and retry.

doc.mx.xdocs-errors-index-html.2.r12: This domain is already used by another account.
doc.mx.xdocs-errors-index-html.2.r13: The webhook address is not valid. Use a public HTTPS address.
doc.mx.xdocs-errors-index-html.4: The error field is a stable machine-readable code that you can compare in your program. It never changes between releases, so build your logic on it and show your own friendly text to your users.
doc.mx.xdocs-errors-index-html.6: During planned maintenance the API answers 503 with a Retry-After header. Your messages are not lost if you retry after the given time, so treat this like any other temporary failure.
doc.mx.xdocs-rate-limits-index-h.2.0: Accepted sends count: every message you queue, including each recipient of a broadcast.
doc.mx.xdocs-rate-limits-index-h.2.1: Rejected requests do not count: invalid input, spam-check rejections and refusals at the limit itself.
doc.mx.xdocs-rate-limits-index-h.2.2: Received mail has its own monthly limit and does not reduce your sending.
doc.mx.xdocs-rate-limits-index-h.4.0: Watch the Usage page. You get a notice at 80 percent of each limit.
doc.mx.xdocs-rate-limits-index-h.4.1: Spread large sends over the day instead of sending everything at once.
doc.mx.xdocs-rate-limits-index-h.4.2: A running broadcast pauses at the limit and continues when the period resets.
doc.mx.xdocs-rate-limits-index-h.4.3: If you need more, upgrade the plan. The change applies immediately.

gdz.0.a0: The General Data Protection Regulation is the European Union law that governs how personal data is collected, used and protected.
gdz.0.a1: It gives people rights over their data: to be informed, to access it, to correct it, to erase it, to object and to take it elsewhere.
gdz.1.a0: Nobody yet. Geserd has no external audit or certification. We describe what we do on the compliance page, so you can judge for yourself.
gdz.2.q: How do I get a signed DPA?
gdz.2.a0: The data processing agreement applies to every account from the moment you sign up. You can read it on the documents page and in the legal section.
gdz.3.a0: The hosting providers and the countries where data is processed are listed on the subprocessors page. We update that list before we change it.
gdz.4.q: How long do you keep data?
gdz.4.a0: Email logs are kept for the number of days of your plan: one day on Free, seven on Pro, thirty on Business and a year on Enterprise. When you delete your account, your data is deleted too.
gdz.5.q: How do I exercise my rights?
gdz.5.a0: Write to support from the address on your account. We send a copy of your data, correct it or delete it, and you may object to processing or contact the data protection authority of your country.
